query: select json_build_object('projects_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_projects),'contributions_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_contributions),'documents_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_documents),'messages_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_messages),'repayments_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_repayments),'payment_transactions_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_payment_transactions),'boosts_count',(select count(*)::integer from public.crowdfunding_boosts),'projects_sample',(select coalesce(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) from (select id,nom,secteur,pays,statut,montant_recherche,montant_collecte,porteur_id,created_at from public.crowdfunding_projects order by created_at desc limit 20) x),'contributions_sample',(select coalesce(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) from (select id,projet_id,investisseur_id,type,montant,created_at from public.crowdfunding_contributions order by created_at desc limit 20) x),'payment_transactions_sample',(select coalesce(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) from (select id,provider_ref,user_id,project_id,contribution_id,amount,currency,status,created_at from public.crowdfunding_payment_transactions order by created_at desc limit 20) x),'boosts_sample',(select coalesce(json_agg(x),'[]'::json) from (select id,project_id,user_id,provider_payment_id,status,created_at from public.crowdfunding_boosts order by created_at desc limit 20) x)) as summary;
